ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, regular pentagon ABCDE is inscribed in circle $O$, and point P is on the minor arc $\overset{\frown}{BC}$ (point P does not coincide with point C). What is the measure of $\angle CPD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw lines OC and OD,\\
$ \because $ the regular pentagon ABCDE is inscribed in $\odot$O,\\
$ \therefore \angle COD=\frac{360^\circ}{5}=72^\circ$,\\
$ \therefore \angle CPD=\frac{1}{2}\angle COD=\boxed{36^\circ}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, with the center labeled O. On the circle, A, B, C, D, E are labeled in order, forming an inscribed regular pentagon ABCDE. Point P is located on the smaller arc between B and C, and the figure draws the line segments from P to C and from P to D, so what is required is the angle ∠CPD with vertex at P. Reasoning: Because ABCDE is a regular pentagon inscribed in circle O, the five minor arcs corresponding to adjacent vertices are equal. The whole circumference is 360°, so each minor arc between adjacent vertices is 360° ÷ 5 = 72°; in particular, the measure of minor arc CD is 72°. Point P is on minor arc BC, not on minor arc CD, so ∠CPD is an inscribed angle intercepting minor arc CD. According to the inscribed angle theorem, an inscribed angle is equal to half the central angle corresponding to the arc it intercepts, so ∠CPD = 72° ÷ 2 = 36°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: a regular pentagon ABCDE is drawn on a circle with center O, P lies on the small arc between B and C, and chords PC and PD form the angle at P. From the text, use that ABCDE is a regular pentagon inscribed in the circle. Therefore the five minor arcs between consecutive vertices are equal, so arc CD has measure 360°/5 = 72°. Since P is on arc BC, it is not on the intercepted minor arc CD, so angle CPD is an inscribed angle intercepting arc CD. Apply the inscribed-angle theorem to get ∠CPD = 1/2 · 72° = 36°.

推理：因为 ABCDE 是圆 O 的内接正五边形，所以相邻两个顶点之间对应的五段小弧相等。整个圆周为 360°，因此每一段相邻顶点间的小弧为 360° ÷ 5 = 72°，特别是小弧 CD 的度数为 72°。点 P 在小弧 BC 上，不在小弧 CD 上，因此 ∠CPD 是截小弧 CD 的圆周角。根据圆周角定理，圆周角等于其所截弧对应圆心角的一半，所以 ∠CPD = 72° ÷ 2 = 36°。
